ADD/RETAIN: magecraft triggers on casting or copying an instant/sorcery, so Anhelo's copy creates another Fractal; token power scales with the spell's mana value. Five mana and non-flying tokens are the trade-offs.
ADD/RETAIN: when copied, each opponent makes a new two-pile split and you choose the pile sacrificed, creating high-impact multiplayer removal rather than only two 2/2 flyers.
ADD: 2/1 body pays casualty 2, ETB surveils two, and it can return from graveyard to hand when an opponent draws their second card each turn. Recurrence is conditional on opponents' extra draw.
ADD: costs {1}{U}, draws a card and creates a 2/2 Zombie with decayed; Anhelo's copy yields two cards and two casualty bodies. Costs one more mana and loses Preordain's scry-two selection.

ADD: base mode exiles up to two cards from a graveyard and creates a 2/2 Rogue for each creature exiled; kicked mode exiles a player's graveyard. Anhelo copies it, and the official ruling says a copy of a kicked spell is also kicked.
